title: Grateful Dead Live at Roscoe Maples Pavilion, Stanford on 1973-02-09
source: SBD>>MR>>REEL>>DAT>>SS>>CDR>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA>>SHN>>COOL EDIT PRO>>SHN; Speed-corrected using Celemony Capstan done for each track individually; Reencoded to flac (level 8); SBE's fixed using Trader's Little Helper

ai_review.summary: Super‑clean soundboard capture of a solid show highlighted by Brown Eyed Women and El Paso, with Phil’s backing vocals shining.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as crisp, clean and well‑balanced – essentially an excellent soundboard source. The performance itself gets kudos for a strong opening, especially the tight “Brown Eyed Women” and a fiery “El Paso,” with Phil Lesh’s backing vocals noted as a standout element.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments on both the musical performance and the crystal‑clear soundboard recording across four detailed reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as super clean, crisp and crispy with vocals well mixed; possible matrix but overall a high‑fidelity board recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show opens strong, serving as a solid launch point that maintains energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Backing vocals highlighted as a key element that elevates the performance.
